exclusions: all geometry, meshes, coordinates and shape-reconstructing derivatives
original or derived NC-SA external geometry and block/drillhole data
raw NPY/NPZ probability or occupancy arrays
limitations: The completed one-time formal final_integrity pass is referenced by hash; adoption does not rerun raw hashes, models, arrays or statistical resampling.
Adopted scalar records and source identities do not include trained weights or saved probability/occupancy arrays and do not independently reproduce the confidential real-case evaluation.
Logical source paths identify the author archive; only each file entry resolves relative to this source-data directory.
missing_or_scope_limited: The formal primary snapshot has six files: five CSV tables plus analysis.json. No sixth primary CSV exists, so none was invented.
The native GENESIM executable/version is not recorded; scikit-mps 0.6.0 is only the Python package version.
Confidential real case-level evidence and geometry are intentionally unavailable; these anonymous aggregates cannot reproduce that evaluation.
External150 derives from one CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 synthetic parent; its 150 rows are not independent geological examples or a new public prediction run.
Local formal source-data adoption is complete; final manuscript/SI cross-references and external publication locations are handled by the root revision package.
